title: Counting subsets of bounded size
statement: Let $J$ be a subset of a finite set and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. The number of subsets of $J$ having size at most $k$ is $\displaystyle\sum_{j=0}^{k}\binom{|J|}{j}$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite subset of the coordinate set $[n]$
